reviewer: A reviewer who has not seen the code

reasons.phone: The phone shot shows one whole shop and half the next: closed shutter, the GOD IS GOOD PHONE & ACCESSORIES board legible, a person for scale; named as lock-up shops at once, but the row and its roof are out of frame and the eave reads as a flat grey band.
reasons.silhouette: The front says four lock-ups under one roof and the gable ends with the tank on its stand say a gabled block; the back is a plain wall with two barred windows.
reasons.proportion: Boards sit under the eave, awnings over the shutters, the tank stand clears the ridge, the person agrees with the shutters; the generator stands a little apart from the wall.
reasons.palette: Palette only; zinc roof, rust patches and the coloured boards and awnings read against the sand; the walls are close in tone to the ground, with the worn band low on the wall.
reasons.wear: Tank on a stand, generator, drain with slabs, dish, meter and cable, rust on the sheets, stains, crates and a cooler, barred back windows, each where it would be; no posters or painted notice.
reasons.variety: Same kit and board style as the plaza and the shopfronts, plainly its own single-storey gabled row.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 656 of 1,500, drawCalls 1 of 1, materials 1 of 1, bytes 7,468 of 40,000; inside every figure, over 80% on at least one.
